refunds (asset fact) — self-service refund, cancellation with refund or account credit: BIZ-010 is gated by `payments` only.

purchase (capability) — sandbox test cards or an operator-approved real payment: BIZ-010 and the completed-order proofs of BIZ-005, BIZ-007 and BIZ-013 need it, and without a tag the planner cannot list them as blocked.

promo-abuse (exclusion tag) — trial, coupon, referral and multi-account abuse is often out of scope in policy text: no exclusion tag exists, so BIZ-005, BIZ-006 and BIZ-012 carry `—` and the policy must be checked by hand.
